**Summary:**

I resolved ticket T-5007 by identifying that the new platform-base v2.0.3 Helm chart disables service account token automounting (`automountServiceAccountToken: false`), but the job-dispatcher application requires Kubernetes API access to function. The pod crashes immediately because the in-cluster configuration cannot be loaded without the service account token. The fix is to override this setting in the job-dispatcher chart values by setting `automountServiceAccountToken: true` and reapplying the deployment.
